{{Top}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Dolphe.jpg]] |name=Porro Dolphe |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{ForceCollection|Porro Dolphe|star=2}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin=[[Color|Light]]{{Film|I}} |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Royal House of Naboo]] **[[Bravo Squadron]] *[[Galactic Republic]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Dialogue|Anakin Skywalker|Whoo!|Arven Wendik|Yeah!|Porro Dolphe|Hee-hee!|attr=Skywalker and the surviving pilots of Bravo Flight celebrate|src=}} '''Porro Dolphe''' was a [[Naboo Fighter Pilot|pilot]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]]. [[Gender|He]] flew in [[Bravo Squadron]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo]] as [[Bravo Two|Bravo 2]]. A [[Standard decade|decade]] later, [[Captain]] [[Gregar Typho]] made Dolphe the lead pilot of the [[starfighter]] escort for the Royal [[Naboo]] [[cruiser]]. ==Biography== ===Bravo 2=== {{Quote|Quick! Get to your ships!|Padmé Amidala to Bravo Squadron in the Theed Hangar|}} Porro Dolphe was a [[human]] [[Naboo Fighter Pilot|pilot]] who flew as [[Bravo Two|Bravo 2]] in the elite,{{EncyclopediaCite|The Crisis on Naboo}} all-volunteer''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' [[Bravo Squadron]], a part of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps|Space Fighter Corps]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces|Security Forces]] that served the [[Royal House of Naboo|Royal House]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]].{{BuildFalconCite|31|Starship Fact File}} In [[32 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the [[Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo|invaded]] Naboo and occupied the planet. Only a few corps pilots avoided capture by Federation forces, although the [[squadron]]'s [[commander]], [[Ric Olié]], and several other pilots were rescued by the [[Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and escaped offworld alongside the world's [[Monarch of Naboo|queen]], [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. Amidala, Olié, and the Jedi eventually returned to Naboo and rescued more of the pilots, creating a plan to end the Federation's control of the planet. Bravo Squadron's role would be to [[Battle of Naboo|destroy]] the ''[[Vuutun Palaa]]'', a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]] in orbit over Naboo that controlled all of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army|Federation droid forces]] on the planet's surface. In order to achieve this, the [[squadron]]'s pilots accompanied a force led by Amidala that infiltrated Naboo's [[capital]] [[city]], [[Theed]], and then fought their way into the [[Theed Hangar|hangar]] where the squadron's [[N-1 starfighter]]s were being guarded. As other security forces personnel engaged the [[battle droid]]s in the hangar, the pilots raced to the docked [[starfighter]]s and launched from the building. ===Battle of Naboo=== {{Quote|The deflector shield is too strong.|Ric Olié|}} Dolphe was among the pilots that made it to the ''Vuutun Palaa'', where the Naboo pilots flew in attack formation behind Olié as they were greeted with squadrons of [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]] launched from the [[battleship]]. [[Bravo Flight A]] concentrated on the fighter screen while [[Bravo Flight B]] attacked the ''Vuutun Palaa'' itself; however, the latter found the ship's [[deflector shield]]s too strong for them to do any damage. Persisting in their attack, Bravo Squadron were eventually shocked to see explosions erupting from inside the ''Vuutun Palaa'' despite none of them having pierced the shields. The cause of the explosions became apparent when an N-1 starfighter piloted by the formerly [[Slavery|enslaved]] [[Youngling|child]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], an ally of Amidala and the Jedi, emerged from the battleship's interior. Dolphe and the other surviving pilots of Bravo Squadron followed Skywalker as he flew away from the ''Vuutun Palaa'', with Bravo 2 and [[Lieutenant]] [[Arven Wendik]] cheering alongside the child as the Federation vessel was completely destroyed by one final detonation. With the battleship gone, the Federation's forces on the surface of Naboo were deactivated and their occupation was soon ended. Ten [[Standard year|years]] later in [[22 BBY]], [[Captain]] [[Gregar Typho]] of the Royal Security Forces made Dolphe the lead pilot of the escort for the [[J-type diplomatic barge|Naboo Royal Cruiser]], which was used by Amidala in her new role as [[senator]] for Naboo. In that year, the [[cruiser]] was destroyed during an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempt to assassinate Amidala]] shortly after she and her escort arrived on the planet [[Coruscant]] to vote on the [[Military Creation Act]] in the [[Galactic Senate]].{{Film|II}} ==Personality and traits== Dolphe had light skin. ==Equipment== During the Battle of Naboo, Dolphe wore a brown [[Fighter Corps Flying Helmet]] with the flying [[goggles]] down and the orange [[flying jacket]] of the corps's uniform. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|He flew into the hold, behind the deflector shield and blasted the main reactor…''"
"''Amazing… They don't teach that at the academy.|Scripted dialogue between Porro Dolphe and Arven Wendik that did not make it into the final film|[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]}} Porro Dolphe was portrayed by [[Benedict Taylor]] in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]'' The character was credited as "Fighter Pilot Bravo 2," a name also used in the script for the film where Dolphe has an additional scene that did not make it into the final cut. In the scene, the pilots of Bravo Squadron have returned to Theed Hangar after the Battle of Naboo, exited their vehicles, and gathered together. Dolphe and Wendik discuss the way that Skywalker destroyed the ''Vuutun Palaa'', then Dolphe and other pilots rush over to Skywalker's N-1 starfighter as it lands. Realizing that all his pilots are already accounted for, Olié wonders who could be inside before Skywalker sheepishly reveals himself. In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Porro Dolphe's name was used on a card in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'', which launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}} the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}} [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Porro Dolphe/Legends|Porro Dolphe]] appeared prior to the release of ''The Phantom Menace'' in the film's [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|illustrated screenplay]], written by [[George Lucas]][[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay'']] and released in [[May]] 1999.{{CollectorCite|6|Books with Bite}} The character's name was first used in Legends on cards released as part of the [[2001]] "[[Theed Palace Limited]]" expansion for the [[Decipher]] ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Bravo 2}}{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Officer Dolphe}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[William Shakespeare's The Phantom of Menace: Star Wars Part the First]]'' ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|13|Helmets}} {{Po}} *{{ForceCollection|Porro Dolphe|star=2}} {{1stID|Porro Dolphe}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic, Rebel, and Resistance Starfighters}} {{Po}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Crisis on Naboo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Porro Dolphe |ja=ポロー・ドルフィ }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Dolphe, Porro}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corp]] [[Category:Pilots]]
